scenes.vo: Three layers: buffer (health factor at least 2–2.5 at entry) to alerts (health factor 2.0 and 1.7, Module 14.1) to action (repay, add collateral, or automated deleveraging tools that repay debt when health factor crosses a trigger; these add their own contract and permission risk). Pre-compute the repayment needed to restore your target health factor: debt to keep = collateral value times LT divided by target health factor.
scenes.cap: Three layers: buffer (HF ≥ 2–2.5 at entry) → alerts (HF 2.0 and 1.7, Module 14.1) → action (repay, add collateral, or automated deleveraging tools that repay debt when HF crosses a trigger; these add their own contract and permission risk). Pre-compute the repayment needed to restore your target HF: debt to keep = collateral value × LT ÷ target HF.

scenes.sub: 10 ETH falls to $2,400 → collateral $24,000, LT 0.8, debt $12,000 → HF 1.6. To restore HF 2.5: debt must be 24,000 × 0.8 ÷ 2.5 = $7,680 → repay $4,320 from the reserve.
